sigmarsComet.description: The target will remember nothing that happens while this card recharges.

conservative.requirements: Eye contact with target within close range. Add if you are engaged with another enemy. Effect: While this card is in play, you may make a request of the target as a manoeuvre. The target may make a Discipline (WP) check to resist. If he fails, he must attempt to comply with your request through any means that he deems reasonable. If he succeeds, this card recharges immediately. The difficulty of the check is determined by the nature of the request, from Daunting (4{Dc}) for trivial and reasonable requests, to Easy (1{Dc}) for dangerous and difficult ones.

success.description: # You beguile the target momentarily and force him to commit a single, sudden act. The target immediately performs one of his available actions of your choice. You make relevant decisions for the target, such as who to target or how to spend boons.
As above, and you may also force the target to perform a single manoeuvre.

boon.description: You can't force the target to spend fortune or suffer fatigue, stress, or wounds as part of the requirements of playing the action, nor to do something obviously suicidal.
Place 2 fewer recharge tokens on this card.

sigmarsComet.description: On your next turn, the target must again perform the action of your choice, as above.

reckless.requirements: Eye contact with target within close range. Add if you are engaged with another enemy.
